description: Look up affiliate, referral and partner program terms. Use when someone asks which companies or tools have an affiliate program, which pay recurring commission, which have the longest cookie window or lowest payout minimum, or wants to compare affiliate programs in a category such as hosting, email or CRM. Returns commission, recurring or one-time, cookie window, minimum payout, payout method and network, each with the vendor page it was read from and the date it was read.

min_cookie_days.description: Only programs whose cookie window is at least this many days (or never expires).

query.description: Words in the program or category name, e.g. "supabase" or "email". Leave out to search everything.

recurring.description: true: only programs that pay on renewals. false: only one-time.

name: search_programs
title: Search affiliate program terms
